'''Center Sphere Flimsinews,''' also known as '''CSFN,''' was a news service operating in the town of [[Bartyn's Landing]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], as of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. It provided a daily edition of news in exchange for one [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]], publishing from their offices in the district [[Center Sphere District]].

Center Sphere Flimsinews was not beyond exaggerating facts to increase sales.
